title: you texted "connect it." your apps joined the conversation.
body:
you wanted your apps in the same conversation. you texted me, signed in, and i checked that we were connected. later, we restarted my computer. your connections were still there. you didn't have to start over. one less thing to think about.

not sure where to start? here are a few things to ask:

"my week is a mess." let's turn the pile into a plan.
"find somewhere good for saturday." a few great places. the details that matter.
"which one should i buy?" compare the price, the details, and what people actually say.
"i don't have an hour for this video." send the link. let's get to the useful part.
"help me find my next job." fewer tabs. better possibilities.
"i have a meeting in an hour." know the people. know the company. walk in ready.
"this needs to stop living in my head." turn the notes into next steps.
"who needs what i'm building?" find the companies. find the right people.
"what are people really saying?" the questions. the complaints. the things worth fixing.
"what are my competitors trying?" see the ads. spot the patterns. find your own angle.
"what should i make next?" find the questions people ask. make something worth finding.
"find creators who fit our brand." a shortlist with a reason behind every name.
"this app should exist." let's turn the idea into something you can use.

your email. your calendar. your notes. your tasks. bring them along.
you choose what to connect. if something costs money, we agree on it first.
less to juggle. more life.
